description:
Build car navigation URLs (Google Maps, Apple Maps, Waze, etc.) via chosen event venues.
選んだイベント会場を経由地に含むカーナビURLを生成する（6サービス対応）。

Google Maps、Apple Maps、Yahoo!カーナビ、Waze、HERE WeGo、MapFanの
URLを一括生成して返す。

destination.description: Destination place name or address (e.g. "Hakone", "箱根"). 目的地（地名・住所）

event_ids.description: Optional event ids (from search results) to show as waypoints on the joino.me route page

origin.description: Start place name or address (e.g. "Tokyo Station", "東京駅"). 出発地（地名・住所）

waypoint_addresses.description: Waypoint addresses in visiting order, e.g. venues of events chosen from search results (up to 10; extra ones are ignored). 経由地の住所リスト（最大10箇所）

name: build_navigation_url
title: Build car navigation URLs
